title: carex maritima subsp. setina
intro: Carex maritima subsp. setina, commonly known as Sea Sedge, is a type of sedges plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing skin irritations. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of Carex maritima subsp. setina include lowering blood pressure, improving wound healing, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
